messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need a final decision on the "burst spillover" behavior for Dedicated reserved pools before Wed launch. Two options on the table: A) Spill to a best-effort pool (soft degrade) up to a configurable hourly cap. B) Strict deny (429 + Retry-After) once reserved quota exhausted. Pros/cons and launch acceptance criteria?

kevin (eng): TL;DR: spill reduces user-facing errors but adds risk to best-effort SLOs. deny keeps isolation strict and is simpler to implement.

sunita (eng-platform): Also depends on telemetry we can emit. If we do spill we need per-tenant accounting for spill usage and clear metrics: spill_bytes, spill_count, spill_latency. Otherwise ops will be blind.

lee (sre): If we choose A, we must add circuit breakers: auto-stop spilling when best-effort latency > 300ms p95 or GPU queue > 75%. Otherwise we shift failures under an opaque banner.

ash (sales): From customer-facing POV many of our early enterprise customers want predictable behavior. They prefer 429 over silent slowdowns, but for PLG users spill is nicer. Can we make it per-customer configurable?

maria (PM): Good point. Proposal: Default to deny for Platinum/Dedicated contracts, default to spill for self-serve tenants with a per-hour cap, and allow explicit opt-in/opt-out per tenant. Launch acceptance must include: 1) telemetry dashboards, 2) rollout flag, 3) docs + sample network policy, 4) automated smoke test that validates both paths.

kevin (eng): Implementation notes: We can add a policy layer in the router that checks pool quota, then picks behavior. Rough sketch:

```
policy = get_tenant_policy(tenant)
if policy.burst_action == "spill":
  route_to_pool("best-effort")
else:
  return 429, {"Retry-After": calc_retry(tenant)}
```

Need to wire metrics and an opt-in flag in tenant config. Estimated effort: 3-4 engineer-weeks + 1 SRE week for monitoring and runbooks.

sunita (eng-platform): For the tenant config, a simple schema suggestion:

```
{"burst": {"mode": "deny|spill", "spill_hourly_limit": 2000, "spill_slo_guard": {"p95_ms": 300, "gpu_queue_pct": 75}}}
```

This keeps configs flat and easy for the console.

lee (sre): Also require an escape hatch: global emergency kill switch + per-region kill. And alerting: page on >5% of tenants spilling for >10m in any region.

ash (sales): Will customers accept per-tenant config? Also need language for contracts: "burst spill is best-effort and not covered by Dedicated SLA". I can draft the clause if we decide to ship A as default for self-serve.

maria (PM): Acceptance criteria checklist for launch (minimal):
- Policy behavior implemented and gated behind a rollout flag (mvp rollout to 10% tenants)
- Tenant config + console toggle for burst.mode
- Metrics: spill_count, spill_tokens, spill_target_latency, spill_activation_events
- SLO guard: stopping spill when p95>300ms or GPU queue>75%
- Runbook & alert: pages and PagerDuty playbook for spill storms
- Contract wording for Dedicated customers (deny by default)

kevin (eng): I'll scope a formal PR with simple router hook + feature-flag. Plan: spike this week, implementation next sprint.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by @kevin (eng) on branch feature/burst-policy-spill -> staging at 1795009944 :rocket:

maria (PM): Cool — @sunita can you own the schema + telemetry? @lee please draft runbook. @ash can you validate customer messaging with two top customers (Acme, Nova). We'll reconvene Fri EOD to decide defaults for GA. Thanks! :thumbsup:
